global_constraints: User-facing copy uses pt-BR; identifiers, code, specifications, and technical documentation use English.
The same entry points run locally and in CI: tool/verify.sh and tool/verify.ps1.
Environment-blocked checks are reported as incomplete, never as passed.
Each touches entry is an exact path exclusively owned by that task. Tasks with overlapping touches never share a wave.
No expected_red field. RED evidence is authored just-in-time by the operator.
Do not deploy, push, import legacy data, or send messages.

tasks.title: Harden emulator gate and CI pins
tasks.summary: Make the emulator security entry fail fast without hosts and pin CI runtimes. Sole owner of gate config and CI workflow in this plan.
acceptance: npm run test:emulator exits non-zero when FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST or FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST is absent instead of silently skipping.
A sentinel test proves the security suite actually executed; a run that omits it cannot report green.
CI pins Flutter stable, Node 20, and the Java runtime for the Firestore emulator and invokes the same verify entry as local runs.
No test file content from other tasks is modified here.

tasks.title: Execute authorization matrix and browser flow
tasks.summary: Run the emulator-backed rules suites and the Chromium browser flow plus Firefox/WebKit smoke. Sole owner of the new proof test and the integration test in this plan.
acceptance: The proof suite asserts supervisor-allow, staff-own-allow, staff-other-deny, self-escalation-deny, allowlisted-owner self-claim, roster and activeEnrollmentRefs grants, and catch-all denial through firebase emulators:exec with project demo-discipulado.

The browser flow covers sign-in, contact homonym create and rename, role replacement, student and class creation, enrollment, attendance save and finalize, progress check, direct-URL reload, history, sign-out, and denied second-congregation access on Chromium with smoke on Firefox and WebKit.
Committed task-2 security tests stay byte-identical; all new assertions live in the proof file listed in touches.
Failures report exact command, exit code, and emulator host state; blocked runs are marked incomplete.

tasks.title: Record executed evidence ledger
tasks.summary: Write the executed versus blocked ledger with versions and responsive findings. Sole owner of docs/verification.md in this plan.
acceptance: docs/verification.md tables every gate command with exit code, actual browser and runtime versions, and the 360, 768, 1440 plus 200-percent-text, reduced-motion, keyboard-only, and screen-reader results.
The report separates executed checks from environment-blocked checks and states the release boundary of no push, deployment, message send, legacy import, or Android packaging.
No gate config or test file from tasks 1-2 is modified in this task.
